text: VK Dental Clinic 2 doesn’t like westerners. They did a good job cleaning my teeth but said i had no cavities, they wanted me gone. I went to dentist in bangkok and had a dead molar removed with repeat visits scheduled for cavities that i was shown visibly on a xray. I think they are just lazy but not honest
